layout: 2 by 2; ak=.1 left, ak=.2 right; parent+Cho above, tracer below

tracer.initial_condition: c/c0=1 in the top finite-volume cell and zero elsewhere; identical surface inventory
tracer.velocity: saved Lagrangian-mean UL, linearly interpolated between 0.1 s snapshots
tracer.concentration_normalization: c/c0, same initial top-cell concentration in both cases
tracer.color_scale: fixed c/(c + c_equilibrium), normalized over c/c0 from 0 to 1; shared across cases and times
tracer.temporal_display: Saved 0.1 s tracer states held between output frames; currents interpolated linearly during tracer integration
tracer.transport_scheme: Conservative finite-volume MUSCL minmod, SSP RK2, centered molecular diffusion; periodic x/y, no flux top/bottom
tracer.scope: Offline diagnostic, not a tracer evolved within the original native simulation. Saved-current cadence and numerical diffusion limit small-scale tracer interpretation.
